scientific_analysis: Frisson arises from dopaminergic reward prediction errors triggered by harmonic surprise, particularly unresolved appoggiaturas suddenly resolving into consonance, which activates the nucleus accumbens and ventral tegmental area. A tempo near 65 BPM entrains with resting heart rate via auditory-motor coupling, lowering defensive arousal while the exposed solo voice recruits mirror-neuron empathy circuits, amplifying chills through vulnerability and acoustic intimacy.

The bridge features a sustained high note held over a suspended chord that slowly resolves into warm vocal harmony, mirrored by soft brushed percussion settling precisely at 65 BPM to echo a resting heartbeat.
